fieldHelp.propertyLabel: A short name you will recognize in lists, like the street or auction lot.
fieldHelp.propertyType: What kind of property this is. Used for defaults and reporting.
fieldHelp.propertyStatus: Where this deal is in your pipeline, from prospect to sold.
fieldHelp.channel: How you found or acquired the property (auction, private sale, etc.).
fieldHelp.complement: Apartment, block, or other extra address detail.
fieldHelp.city: City where the property is located.
fieldHelp.state: Two-letter state code, e.g. SP or CA.
fieldHelp.postalCode: Postal code used to autofill the address.
fieldHelp.cep: Brazilian CEP. Autofills street, district, city, and state via ViaCEP.
fieldHelp.zip: US ZIP code. Autofills city and state. Street still needs to be entered.
fieldHelp.country: Country of the property. Chooses CEP or ZIP lookup.
fieldHelp.areaTotal: Total land or unit area in square meters.
fieldHelp.yearBuilt: Year the building was constructed, if known.
fieldHelp.purchasePrice: What you paid or expect to pay for the property itself.
fieldHelp.purchaseDate: Date you acquired (or expect to acquire) the property.
fieldHelp.marketValue: Your estimate of current market value.
fieldHelp.targetSale: The sale price you are aiming for.
fieldHelp.itbiRate: Transfer tax as a percent, e.g. 3.
fieldHelp.auctionCommission: Auctioneer commission as a percent, e.g. 5.
fieldHelp.brokerCommission: Broker fee as a percent of the sale price, e.g. 6.
fieldHelp.capitalGains: Estimated capital gains tax rate as a percent, e.g. 15. Not tax advice.
fieldHelp.notes: Free-form notes for yourself about this deal or property.
fieldHelp.scenarioName: Name this scenario so you can compare alternatives later.
fieldHelp.deedAndRegistry: Estimated deed, notary, and registry costs.
fieldHelp.legalFees: Lawyer or legal advisory fees for acquisition.
fieldHelp.otherAcquisition: Any other one-off costs to get possession.
fieldHelp.holdingMonths: How many months you expect to hold before selling.
fieldHelp.monthlyHolding: Average monthly holding cost (condo, utilities, IPTU, etc.).
fieldHelp.financed: Portion of the purchase financed by a loan.
fieldHelp.annualRateBps: Loan annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 10.5.
fieldHelp.expectedSale: Price you expect to sell for in this scenario.
fieldHelp.targetRoi: Target return as a decimal. 0.20 means 20%.
fieldHelp.renovationQty: Quantity for this preset (m², units, etc.).
fieldHelp.listingPrice: Public asking price while the property is listed.
fieldHelp.email: We use this for login codes and account recovery.
fieldHelp.phone: Optional contact number. Format with area code.
fieldHelp.phoneIntl: Include country code. We send the one-time code here.
fieldHelp.otp: 6-digit code from your email or SMS.
fieldHelp.fullName: How your name appears on your account.
fieldHelp.contactName: Person or company name you will search for later.
fieldHelp.trade: Main trade or profession for filtering contacts.
fieldHelp.company: Business name, if different from the contact name.
fieldHelp.taxId: CPF or CNPJ. Mask adjusts automatically by length.
fieldHelp.whatsapp: WhatsApp number for quick messaging from the contact list.
fieldHelp.contactEmail: Email for quotes, contracts, or scheduling.
fieldHelp.contactCity: City where this contact usually works.
fieldHelp.contactState: State/UF where this contact usually works.
fieldHelp.favorite: Pin favorites to the top of filters.
fieldHelp.contactNotes: Private notes about quality, pricing, or past jobs.
fieldHelp.expenseAmount: Amount spent or planned for this cost.
fieldHelp.expenseCategory: Groups this cost in your profit breakdown.
fieldHelp.expenseDescription: What this expense was for — shows in lists and exports.
fieldHelp.expenseDate: When the cost was incurred or is planned.
fieldHelp.expenseStatus: Planned, pending confirmation, or already paid.
fieldHelp.lender: Bank or lender name for this loan.
fieldHelp.ratePercent: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 10.5.
fieldHelp.amortization: SAC has falling payments; Price keeps installments more level.
fieldHelp.firstDue: Due date of the first installment.
fieldHelp.adminFee: Optional monthly admin fee charged by the lender.
fieldHelp.recurringDescription: Label for generated expenses, e.g. Condo fee.
fieldHelp.frequency: How often this cost should be generated.
fieldHelp.dayOfMonth: Day of the month to generate the expense (1–31).
fieldHelp.startDate: First date this rule can generate costs.
fieldHelp.endDate: Optional last date. Leave empty to keep generating.
fieldHelp.taskTitle: Short name for the renovation or work item.
fieldHelp.assignee: Optional contact responsible for this task.
fieldHelp.taskDescription: Details, scope, or notes for the job.
